contracts.goal: Dispatch a POSTed JSON-RPC 1.1 request to a registered method script through a fixed pipeline: parse, lookup, privilege check, argument-presence check, source script

input_shape.http.method: string, must be POST for this path
input_shape.env.CONTENT_LENGTH: integer string, number of characters to read from stdin; missing -> Tcl error -> error 200
input_shape.body.method: string, exact case-sensitive key of METHOD_LIST
input_shape.body.params: object (flattened to even-length Tcl list); keys become args() element names
input_shape.body.id: optional JSON value, echoed verbatim without re-quoting
input_shape.header.Content-Type: string; must be 'application/json' in strict mode and on all v2 paths; unrestricted on v1 default
input_shape.header.X-Requested-With: non-empty string; required in strict mode and on v2 paths
input_shape.header.X-Session-Id: string, v2 only, sid alternative to params._session_id_ (name locked, BD-05)
input_shape.body (v2/batch): array<{id?: any JSON, method: string, params: object}>, length 1..configured batch limit

output_shape.success: single-line JSON {"id"?: <raw>, "version": "1.1", "result": <method-specific JSON or null>, "error": null} with header CONTENT-TYPE: application/json; charset=utf-8, always HTTP 200
output_shape.error: multi-line JSON {id?, version '1.1', result null, error{name 'JSONRPCError', code integer, message string}} with HTTP 200
output_shape.v2 error: same JSON-RPC error envelope with a real HTTP status (mapping locked in BD-04)
output_shape.v2/batch success: array<response envelope>, same order and length as request

error_cases.when: rate_limit=false or true and 60 requests with header X-Session-Id: AbCdEf1234 on POST /api/v2/rpc within 10 s AND WHEN the 61st request with the same header arrives within that 10 s

error_cases.then: it executes after the body/params are parsed (sid known) and before method lookup, privilege check, argument check and script sourcing; the counter lives in one file per sid under /tmp/webui-ratelimit/ (name sid-<sid with characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] mapped to '_', truncated to 64>) holding request timestamps of the last per_sid_window_seconds (10), replaced by write-to-temp-then-rename; on v2 Retry-After is the integer seconds until the oldest counted request leaves the window (1..10)

invariants: Pipeline order is fixed: strict-mode check, parse, rate-limit check (only when active), lookup, privilege check, argument-presence check, script sourcing (privilege check precedes the argument check)
SCRIPT_FILE comes only from methods.conf; a client value never selects the sourced path
With default configuration (strict_mode=false, v2_enabled=false, config_tool_mode=false, rate_limit=false) every v1 response keeps HTTP 200, version 1.1 and the raw id echo
No Access-Control-* header is emitted unless allowed_origin is configured
Privilege level of the method is enforced before any side effect (SP003); no response contains errorInfo or filesystem paths (NFR-006)
v2 behaviour is additive: the v1 contract of the same methods is not altered (NFR-045)
Rate limiting is opt-in: the per-sid limiter runs only when rate_limit=true, strict_mode=true or on /api/v2; otherwise no counter file is touched and no 429 is produced

contracts.goal: Load and interpret the methods.conf registry (179 entries) giving LEVEL, SCRIPT_FILE, optional METHOD_FILE, INFO and ARGUMENTS per JSON-RPC method

input_shape.methods.conf: Tcl list text, ISO-8859-1: name {LEVEL <NONE|GUEST|USER|ADMIN> SCRIPT_FILE <relpath> [METHOD_FILE <relpath>] INFO {<text>} ARGUMENTS {<names...>}}

output_shape.METHOD_LIST: Tcl array: methodName -> list(LEVEL string, SCRIPT_FILE string, METHOD_FILE string?, INFO string, ARGUMENTS list<string>)
output_shape.namespaces: 19 prefixes: BidCoS, BidCoS_RF, BidCoS_Wired, CCU, Channel, Device, Event, Firewall, Interface, Program, ReGa, Room, SafeMode, Session, Subsection, SysVar, User, WebUI, system
output_shape.cache: registry cache file or in-process array keyed by methods.conf mtime

preconditions.condition: methods.conf in the CGI working directory AND WHEN a request starts
a method entry AND WHEN dispatched

postconditions.condition: the registry is served from a precompiled/cached array that is rebuilt only when the mtime of methods.conf is newer than the cache, so an unchanged methods.conf is parsed 0 times per request after the first (all 179 entries carry LEVEL, SCRIPT_FILE, INFO, ARGUMENTS; 49 also carry METHOD_FILE interface/dispatch.tcl)

LEVEL is one of NONE(0), GUEST(1), USER(2), ADMIN(8); target distribution after the deliberate changes is ADMIN 93 (92 incl. RecoveryMode.enter, + CCU.createFile), GUEST 48 (48 - createFile + Session.logout; CCU.existsFile stays GUEST per EG-3), USER 30, NONE 8 (9 - Session.logout) = 179 entries

error_cases.then: 'can't read USER_LEVEL(<x>)' is raised and reported as error 200

error_cases.when: methods.conf is malformed Tcl (unbalanced braces) or unreadable
error_cases.then: the dispatcher answers JSON-RPC error 200 with a correlation id (no CGI crash without envelope, no errorInfo) and logs the parse error to syslog; with a missing file every call returns 401 as in v1

error_cases.when: the staged methods.conf is written (user decision C, 2026-10-20)
error_cases.then: it stays ISO-8859-1 with CRLF line endings, untouched registry lines stay byte-identical to the legacy file, and registry edit collisions with OpenCCU patches 0038, 0044, 0057, 0109, 0131 and 0205 are documented in COPY-PLAN.md as 'patch N must be regenerated at the next Base bump'

error_cases.then: checkPrivilegeLevel is never invoked (lines 147-149)

contracts.goal: Parse the JSON-RPC request body with a hand-written JSON parser into a flat Tcl structure and validate envelope fields

input_shape.request: string (CONTENT_LENGTH chars), JSON object {id?: any, method: string, params: object|array}
input_shape.state.JSONRPC: array with METHOD string, PARAMS list, ID string (default '"error"'), ID_USED 0|1

output_shape.JSONRPC(PARAMS): Tcl list of alternating key/value (values: string | nested list)

preconditions.condition: a well-formed JSON object containing method and params (and optionally id) AND WHEN jsonrpc_parse runs
a request without 'id' AND WHEN processed
a request with "id":"abc-1" (JSON string) AND WHEN the response is built

postconditions.condition: json_parse returns a flat Tcl key/value list, the whole list is converted from UTF-8 (jsonrpc.tcl:24), JSONRPC(METHOD) and JSONRPC(PARAMS) are set and JSONRPC(ID) is set when present, else ID_USED=0 (lines 27-35)

postconditions.condition: ID_USED=0 and the response omits the id member entirely (jsonrpc.tcl:27-29, 52-54, 83-85)
the id is echoed JSON-quoted as "id": "abc-1" (valid JSON); numeric ids ("id":7) and null ids round-trip unchanged
